page.notes: Woodcut initials: "R" of RAbbi and "S" of Sacerdos (printed as S-initial, read as Sacerdos). Greek word after "sacra" (printed as ἱερά in italic) is doubtful. The word "piusfe" in the entry "ritibus impijs amicitiæ prætextu piusfe non admi-fceat" is doubtful. Several lines of the right column are continuations; the numbers 3 and 1 beside sacræ Historiæ and sacri libri are read as printed. No printed page number is visible on the scan. Entries are copied as printed, including spelling and numbering variants (e.g. "dicantur", "16.b", "15"). Left-column line "rafura capitis ... ui-/fa est" hyphen is read as a printed line break.
